templates.title: Pre-Rental and Post-Rental Vehicle Inspection Form

sections.heading: Rental identification
body: Complete one form per vehicle movement. Circle Pre or Post at the top before starting.

fields: Renter last name as on agreement:

sections.heading: Exterior walkaround
body: Walk clockwise from the front bumper. Mark each flaw with X scratch or chip, D dent, C crack, S stain, T tire or wheel damage, plus panel and approximate size.

sections.heading: Interior, controls, and equipment
body: Check with ignition on where indicated. Note warning lights by name.

fields: Climate system, lights, signals, wipers, horn:
Mirrors, spare, jack, tools where equipped:
Cargo area condition and photos taken:

sections.heading: Photos and sign-off
body: Minimum photo set: front three-quarter, rear three-quarter, each side, odometer and fuel cluster, close-up of every marked flaw.

fields: Photo filenames or phone roll reference:
Renter refused walkaround (note time if so):

sections.heading: Sender and claim identification
body: Keep to one page where possible. Attach the timeline as a second page for complex cases.

fields: Vehicle: Unit ID, year, make, model, VIN:

sections.heading: What happened
body: State dated facts only. No conclusions about fault or motive.

fields: Damage description with panel and measurements:

sections.heading: Enclosed evidence
body: List each enclosure by name so the reviewer can check them off.

fields: Enclosure 3 (for example photo set with count):

sections.heading: Amount requested and response sought
body: State the amount with its basis and a specific reply date.

fields: Contact name and phone for questions:

sections.heading: Vehicle and visit details
body: Complete at drop-off. Attach the shop invoice on pickup and reconcile with the workbook.

sections.heading: Work performed and parts
body: Copy from the shop invoice. Keep the invoice stapled to this sheet in the vehicle folder.

sections.heading: Workbook update
body: Update the Maintenance Log the day the vehicle returns to service.
